follow-up time: Until delivery and the neonatal period
exposure: Women without a history of RPL
Women with a history of RPL
cohort: 104,102 registered children and their mothers from the Japan Environment and Children's Study (JECS)
finding: Multiple-imputed analyses revealed that women with three or more previous pregnancy losses had an increased risk of various adverse pregnancy outcomes, including placental adhesion, uterine infection, and hypertensive disorders of pregnancy.
mod_finding: Women with three or more previous pregnancy losses had an increased risk of caesarean section.
